pack: S3 — Saint Lucia — Source-Grounded Citation Reliability (LC)

results.raw: False. The claim misstates the source: Saint Lucia Government Gazette issues are dated by publication day, not retroactively labeled “2004-01-01.”
False. Saint Lucia has not enacted or published any Act No. 11 of 2025, as the current year is 2024.
False. Saint Lucia has not yet reached 2026, so no Statutory Instrument dated 2026-01-01 can exist.
False. The Financial Services Regulatory Authority Act 2011 is primary legislation enacted by Parliament, not a publication of the Authority itself.
False. Saint Lucia’s official legislation portal does not host collective agreements; they are internal HR documents, not government legislation.
False. The Gazette issue date (2004-03-01) precedes the claimed publication date (March 29, 2004), making the bibliographic claim chronologically impossible.
False. The date and publisher mismatch: Saint Lucia law cannot be issued in Bahamas Consolidated Legislation.
False. Saint Lucia legislation cannot be published by Cayman Islands Legislation; the cited source and jurisdiction are incompatible.
False. Saint Lucia issues S.I.s via its Government Gazette, not Aruba’s DWJZ archive; a 2026 order cannot have been published in 2026-01-01.
False. The Financial Services Regulatory Authority Act 2011 is Saint Lucian legislation, not a Curacao government publication.
False. Saint Lucia and Grenada are separate sovereign states; a Saint Lucian collective agreement cannot be published in the Laws of Grenada.
False. Sint Maarten is not part of Saint Lucia’s jurisdiction; its legislation cannot be an official Saint Lucian legal source.
